Package be.imgn.gaia.processing.source

@NullMarked package be.imgn.gaia.processing.source
A model of the Java source code a processor generates: type names, code blocks, annotations, fields, methods and types, written out as a JavaFile whose imports are worked out for it. 
Method greet = Method.newBuilder("greet")
        .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.STATIC)
        .returns(String.class)
        .addParameter(String.class, "name")
        .addStatement("return $S + $N", "Hello, ", "name")
        .build();
Type greeter = Type.newClassBuilder("Greeter")
        .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.FINAL)
        .addMethod(greet)
        .build();
JavaFile file = JavaFile.newBuilder("com.example", greeter).build();

Code is written with placeholders: $T for a type, imported as needed; $N for the name of a parameter, field, method or type; $S for a string literal; $L for anything written as is, such as a number or another code block; $$ for a dollar sign; $> and $< to indent and unindent; $[ and $] around a statement; $W and $Z where a long line may break. Arguments are taken in order, by position with $1T, $2N and so on, or by name with $type:T; see CodeBlock.
